name: pig-observational-memory-animation
description: Clayzo sources for the README banner and mascot (docs/assets/*.svg).

scripts.check: npm run build && clayzo render-frame out/banner.json out/sheet.png --samples 6 --max-dimension 1280 && clayzo render-frame out/banner.json out/seam.png --seam --max-dimension 640
scripts.export: npm run build && clayzo export out/banner.json ../assets/banner.svg --format svg && clayzo export out/mascot.json ../assets/spider-ham.svg --format svg && node finish-svg.ts ../assets/banner.svg "pig-observational-memory: PiG's Spider-Ham pixel pig drops in on a web line beside the PiG. wordmark" 4.2667 && node finish-svg.ts ../assets/spider-ham.svg "Spider-Ham, PiG's red pixel pig"
